The developer you buy from pays us a commission, and we only introduce you to developers we have a written agreement with. The short version You pay us nothing , at any stage. We never take money from buyers, for anything. The developer pays us. When you buy a home from a developer we introduced you to, that developer pays us a commission. Developers set their own prices, and we add nothing to them. We only introduce you to developers we work with. Each one has a written agreement with us, so the homes you hear about from us are theirs, and we will always say so. We don't act for you in the purchase.
